claude.rationale: gap_45=1: the customer-facing product/services operation (T4 — fabrication/product sales, contract operations, aftermarket services, plus the "Exterran" marks) crossed to the new company, but the operational corporate service substrate that produces/delivers it (finance, legal, tax, treasury, IT, HR, internal audit, real property, T5) "had not been operated as a separate, stand-alone company" and was "historically provided centrally by the parent" rather than transferred as an intact operating whole — a documented product-vs-process mismatch at closing. gap_mitigated=yes: that gap was contractually absorbed via the Transition Services Agreement (interim corporate services up to one year) plus the Separation/Distribution, Employee Matters, Supply and services agreements. gap_56=0: the ~7,000 employees and the processes moved together with the organization for the transferred businesses, and the Employee Matters Agreement transferred employment-related liabilities and account balances to post-distribution employers, so processes and people were aligned rather than mismatched at closing.

gemini.rationale: The transaction was a spin-off where the international and fabrication businesses (T4) transferred along with their direct operations (T5), so there is no gap_45. However, the corporate functions (finance, IT, HR, etc.) were historically centralized and not transferred as an intact operating whole, creating a gap_56 (operations transferred without the full organizational substrate). This gap was mitigated by a Transition Services Agreement.

grok.rationale: At closing the integrated customer-facing segments (international contract operations, international aftermarket services, and global fabrication/product sales) crossed together with their producing and delivering operations, so T4 and core T5 moved as one package and gap_45=0. The new company simultaneously received approximately 7,000 employees and employment-related liabilities under the Employee Matters Agreement, aligning T6 with those operations, so gap_56=0; the centralized corporate substrate that did not cross intact was separately bridged by the Transition Services Agreement and is reflected in the partial T5/T6 codes rather than as an unmitigated tier-transfer gap.
